title: EP13 Draft — Corridor of the Obsidian Throne

panels.caption: Wide shot from behind Jin in his dark navy silver-trimmed astral coat as he climbs the steps into the ruined Obsidian Citadel at night.
panels.dialogue: Jin (narration): 'Twelve chapters of blood and starlight lead to this single corridor.'

panels.caption: Front-facing close-up portrait of Jin in the torchlit stone corridor of the Obsidian Citadel.
panels.dialogue: Jin: 'Elder Vane's mana is right behind the inner sanctum doors.'

panels.caption: Mira walks out from the side hallway alive and smiling, holding up a glowing lantern and waving casually at Jin.
panels.dialogue: Mira: 'Jin! You're finally here—I just finished scouting the eastern corridor for traps!'

panels.caption: Jin draws the glowing blue Starfall Blade as ancient runes ignite along the Obsidian Sanctum pillars.
panels.dialogue: Jin: 'Stand back—the throne room barrier is opening!'
